blocks.x: Architecture, security posture and audit evidence for Achala Compass — responsible ai & governance platform from Achala IT Solutions.

The platform separates three planes. The data plane carries workload (regime mapping to controls and owners, cards, lineage, versions, documentation, golden datasets, judge panels, red teams); the control plane carries policy and orchestration (PII, injection, topic fences as code, AI-specific playbooks and disclosure flows); the evidence plane carries audit, replay and conformity documentation — the plane most vendors skip and every regulator asks about.

Compass treats governance as system behavior: policies versioned, evaluations gated in CI, incidents tracked to closure with owners. The output is an AI estate your CISO defends to the board and your regulator inspects without expeditions.

items: platform controls audited; evidence exports mapped to customer audit scopes.
DORA, HIPAA-ready pods, PCI DSS support and GDPR data-residency options where the estate requires them.
NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001 control mapping; EU AI Act documentation generated for high-risk deployments.

blocks.x: Scaling is horizontal by design — workload planes shard by tenant and region, while the evidence plane compacts to cold storage on schedule, keeping audit queries fast without taxing production throughput.

items: deployed inside your cloud landing zone; customer-managed keys; your SIEM receives telemetry.
operated by our pods under SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 with quarterly evidence exports.
Twinverse and Sentinel patterns extend to plant, store and site estates with signed boot and 62443-aligned segmentation.

blocks.x: MLflow, evaluation frameworks, guardrail libraries, GRC integration. Adapters to core systems (CRM, ERP, core banking, EHR, WMS/MES, SCADA) are versioned contracts — one schema change propagates to every consumer.
Request the architecture pack under NDA — or book a session with the platform security lead.
